name: Jenaer Trödelmarkt

rhythm.de: Etwa monatlich an einem Samstag, Februar bis Oktober
rhythm.en: Roughly monthly on a Saturday, February to October

facts: in Jena's city centre, run by the city's own cultural service
no trade licence needed to take a stall
pitches handed out on the morning, 06:00 to 07:45, at the corner of Löbderstraße and Kollegiengasse
stall fee 5 EUR per square metre per day
draws several thousand visitors into the old town
notes: Season is February to October: 17 October 2026 is the last date of the year and 2027 is not published yet, so only two dates fall inside the window. The organiser page gives no entry price; the city's own event listing for this market (https://www.jena-veranstaltungen.de/event/jenaer-troedelmarkt) says 'Eintritt frei', so fee is 0. The market fills the pedestrian streets around the Löbderstraße and the city gives no single street number — coordinates are Löbderstraße from Nominatim. Contact on the page is the Marktmeister, Oliver Klinke, Löbdergraben 14a.

description.de: Etwa monatlich an einem Samstag von Februar bis Oktober mitten in der Jenaer Altstadt, ausgerichtet vom städtischen Kulturbetrieb. Antiquitäten, Sammlerstücke und Bücher; Neuware ist nicht erlaubt, ein Gewerbeschein nicht nötig. Plätze werden morgens zwischen 6 und 7.45 Uhr vergeben.
description.en: Roughly monthly on a Saturday from February to October in the middle of Jena's old town, run by the city's own cultural service. Antiques, collectors' pieces and books; new goods are not allowed and no trade licence is needed. Pitches are handed out between 6 and quarter to 8 in the morning.
